privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: Your saved list stays in this browser. We don't send it anywhere and we can't see it.
We don't ask for an account, and we don't collect your name or email to use this site.
Clearing your browser data clears your saved list with it.
Questions about your data? Reach us through the links at the bottom of any page.
